description: PAID $0.02 USDC. Pre-trade and pre-scrape safety verdict: one compact PROCEED / CAUTION / ABORT signal plus a 0-100 risk score for a token and/or a URL. Token side (chain: base, bsc, ethereum or solana) uses our own on-chain scanner (honeypot buy/sell simulation, mint/owner flags, burned LP, taxes). URL side is a light HTTPS pre-flight (status, anti-bot hint, prompt-injection and zero-width text scan). Fields we cannot compute (EVM top-10 holders, 24h whale flow, locker-contract liquidity) are null plus a reason and never become PROCEED. Hard ABORT on honeypot, prompt injection, or sell/buy tax of 50% or more. Response is EIP-191 signed; verify against GET /.well-known/verdict-signer.json. At least one of contractAddress or targetUrl is required after payment. No charge on bad input or if both requested sides fail.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain of contractAddress. One of base, bsc, ethereum, solana. Default base. Ignored for URL-only calls.

contractAddress.description: Token contract (0x + 40 hex) or Solana mint. Optional if targetUrl is set. Example: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 on base.

targetUrl.description: HTTPS URL to pre-flight (status, anti-bot hint, prompt-injection scan). Optional if contractAddress is set. http, file, and private/loopback addresses are refused.

name: safety_verdict
